title: Alibaba Cloud releases Qwen-72B and Qwen-1.8B model weights for download, China Daily reports
summary: Alibaba released its 72-billion and 1.8-billion-parameter models for download.

title: IBM, Meta and about 50 other organisations form the AI Alliance for Responsible Innovation
summary: A 2023 timeline lists the alliance as launched in December by IBM, Meta and 50 other organisations.

title: AMD presents Instinct MI300X and MI300A accelerators for AI, 3DNews reports
summary: AMD introduced the MI300X GPU and MI300A accelerated processor for AI and high-performance computing.

title: Google presents Gemini, a family of multimodal AI models, 3DNews reports
summary: Gemini was announced in three sizes, Nano, Pro and Ultra, as a challenger to GPT-4.

title: EU Council and Parliament reach a provisional agreement on the AI Act after three days of talks
summary: After three days of marathon negotiations the Council of the EU and the European Parliament agreed a provisional text of the Artificial Intelligence Act.

title: Mistral AI releases open-weight Mixtral 8x7B via a torrent link
summary: Mistral posted the Apache-2.0 mixture-of-experts model on 9 December and published it on Hugging Face and its blog two days later.

title: Mistral AI raises EUR 385 million from Andreessen Horowitz, BNP Paribas and Salesforce, NYT reports
summary: Mistral announced its second funding round, with investors including Andreessen Horowitz, BNP Paribas and Salesforce.

title: Euractiv: Albania to use ChatGPT to speed up its EU accession work
summary: The government decided to use ChatGPT to translate EU documents quickly and analyse the changes needed for accession.

title: Intel presents its Gaudi3 AI accelerator, 3DNews reports
summary: Intel announced the Gaudi3 accelerator for AI training and inference at its AI Everywhere event.

title: OpenAI gives its board the right to block releases of potentially dangerous AI models, 3DNews reports
summary: 3DNews reports that OpenAI's board gained the right to stop the release of models judged potentially dangerous, under the company's Preparedness Framework.

title: Midjourney releases the alpha of version 6, trained from scratch over nine months
summary: Version 6 improves text rendering and follows prompts more literally than earlier versions.

title: Stanford Internet Observatory reports child sexual abuse material in the LAION-5B training dataset
summary: David Thiel's report found abuse material in LAION-5B, the dataset used to train models such as Stable Diffusion.

title: The New York Times sues OpenAI and Microsoft for copyright infringement over AI training
summary: The newspaper sued the two companies over the use of its content to train AI models.

title: GPAI summit opens in New Delhi (12-14 Dec) and adopts the New Delhi Declaration on AI opportunities and risks
summary: Prime Minister Modi inaugurated the Global Partnership on AI summit at Bharat Mandapam, where members adopted a declaration committing to manage AI risks while upholding human rights and accountability.

title: Lenta.ru: an AI-generated double of Putin puts a question to him during his televised year-end Direct Line
summary: During the broadcast Putin was addressed by a synthetic video likeness of himself speaking in his voice and remarked that it could resemble him and speak with his voice.

title: Korean startup Upstage unveils its in-house large language model Solar for global competition, Byline Network reports
summary: Upstage publicly released its self-developed LLM Solar, positioning it to compete internationally.

title: China's National Data Administration issues draft 'Data Element x' three-year plan backing training of general and sector AI models
summary: The draft 2024-2026 action plan, published for comment via the NDRC website, includes support for training general-purpose and vertical-domain large AI models with data resources.

title: Japan's government presents draft AI guidelines for businesses with 10 principles including 'human-centric' and 'safety'
summary: The draft AI business operator guidelines, shown to the government's AI Strategy Council, set ten principles for developers, providers and users of AI.

title: RFA: Taiwan FactCheck Center debunks an AI lip-synced video of a US lawmaker appearing to back Lai Ching-te before the election
summary: The video, spread on Facebook, TikTok and PTT in the last week of 2023, spliced an old interview with an altered voice and AI-matched lip movements.
